nodes.name: .env.example
nodes.summary: Documents the production runtime settings for the TanStack server, PostgreSQL-backed CMS, admin seeding, transactional email, uploads, Shopify Storefront and Admin APIs, and encrypted customer sessions.

nodes.name: AUDIT_REPORT_2026-07-15.md
nodes.summary: Records the July 2026 snag audit, remediation outcome, detailed launch checklist, remaining priorities, verification performed, and release sign-off recommendation.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Project operations and change record covering UX hardening, launch inputs, the CMS/admin runbook, database migrations, admin seeding, persistent uploads, Coolify deployment, commerce flows, and verification.

nodes.name: SHOPIFY_CATALOGUE_GUIDE.md
nodes.summary: Explains how developers synchronize manual Shopify collections and how clients publish products to the Headless channel, assign main and product-line collections, bulk-edit existing products, and troubleshoot storefront visibility.

nodes.name: bunfig.toml
nodes.summary: Controls Bun package installation behavior for the project through its install section.

nodes.name: components.json
nodes.summary: Configures the shadcn component generator, including TSX output, Tailwind integration, icon library, directionality, source aliases, and component registries.

nodes.name: docker-entrypoint.sh
nodes.summary: Container startup script that repairs ownership of the persistent data volume before dropping privileges to the node user and executing the application command.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses POSIX shell fail-fast flags and su-exec for privilege dropping.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: Defines the private ESM application package, its development, build, database, Shopify synchronization, test, and formatting scripts, plus the React/TanStack, Shopify, Drizzle, email, and UI dependency set.

nodes.name: shopify-dummy-products.csv
nodes.summary: Shopify-compatible seed catalogue containing industrial spare products with handles, HTML descriptions, vendors, types, collection tags, variants, inventory, prices, shipping and tax flags, images, SEO copy, and active status.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: Configures TypeScript compilation for the application, including the project include set and compiler behavior used by TanStack Start and the React source tree.
